name: mini-order-crm
description: Convenience scripts for the Mini Order Management CRM (backend = single NestJS monolith, frontend = React SPA)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
